concept.title: The Forges of Dunmaw
concept.logline: On ash-choked, epic Dunmaw, you wander far to recover the cooling gems and restore the Ember Shrine.
concept.source_prompt: Obsidian Mesa. obsidian basalt scorched ash exploration Grand tour
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Basalt Refuge and becomes the one who brings the Ember Shrine back to life.

key_locations.name: Basalt Refuge
key_locations.description: The start: a stone shelter cut into cooled lava.

key_locations.name: Miners' Camp
key_locations.description: Miners' Camp: a camp of Dunmaw, reached by the trail from Basalt Refuge.

key_locations.name: Pumice Village
key_locations.description: Pumice Village: a village on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

key_locations.name: Fire Fern Grove
key_locations.description: Fire Fern Grove: a grove on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

key_locations.name: Ash Beacon
key_locations.description: Ash Beacon: a tower of Dunmaw, reached by the trail from Basalt Refuge.

key_locations.name: Ember Shrine
key_locations.description: Ember Shrine: the far end of the hub and spokes, where the story ends.

characters.name: Forgemaster Lyra
characters.description: Waits in Basalt Refuge and knows why the Ember Shrine fell silent.

characters.name: Isla the Apprentice
characters.description: Follows you from Basalt Refuge and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Cinder Hound
characters.description: A cinder hound that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Wren the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Dunmaw for anything shiny.

characters.name: Ash Beetle
characters.description: A harmless ash beetle that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Visit every region, in any order
hazards: Ash sweeping the exposed ground around the Ember Shrine
Lava vents that scorch anyone who lingers
Cinder Hound hunting near its lair

actions.value: On ash-choked, epic Dunmaw, you wander far to recover the cooling gems and restore the Ember Shrine.
Explore all 5 corners of The Forges of Dunmaw, in any order, then head home.
You reach the Fire Fern Grove.
Home again, with the whole map in your head.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Lyra
nodes.text: So you've come to Basalt Refuge at last. I am Forgemaster Lyra. On ash-choked, epic Dunmaw, you wander far to recover the cooling gems and restore the Ember Shrine.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Lyra
nodes.text: Back again. Basalt Refuge is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Lyra
nodes.text: Go to Miners' Camp, then Pumice Village. Whatever still remembers The Forges of Dunmaw is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Lyra
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Basalt Refuge, The Forges of Dunmaw was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Grim, even then.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Lyra
nodes.text: Miners' Camp: Miners' Camp: a camp of Dunmaw, reached by the trail from Basalt Refuge.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Lyra
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of The Forges of Dunmaw back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Lyra
nodes.text: Pumice Village: Pumice Village: a village on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

nodes.speaker: Isla the Apprentice
nodes.text: Isla the Apprentice circles your feet, then looks toward Pumice Village as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Isla the Apprentice
nodes.text: Isla the Apprentice sniffs the air. Something about Pumice Village has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Isla the Apprentice
nodes.text: It turns toward Pumice Village. Pumice Village: a village on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

nodes.speaker: Cinder Hound
nodes.text: The cinder hound watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Wren the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Basalt Refuge. Wren the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Wren the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of The Forges of Dunmaw that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Wren the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Fire Fern Grove after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Ash Beetle
nodes.text: The ash beetle freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
